CTO #25 six-team frontier dispatch). Scheduled lane triggers are therefore unreliable timing references under load, and their late arrival maximizes collision probability with self-dispatched chains.

STRUCTURAL GAP, second distinct instance of the queued-run-destruction family (cf. Product supervisor dedupe in runs/32894986672.json): runtime-loop.yml's own runtime_repair_router (and director self-relaunch) create newer pending runs WITHOUT any co-existence guard for already-pending scheduled runs, while the cron trigger has no dedupe either. Under cancel-in-progress:false semantics this makes every cron fresh-cycle slot a silent casualty whenever a REVISE chain is mid-flight — benign in cost here (zero tokens), but it means the 'periodic safety-net fresh cycle' assumption does not hold, and cancelled-while-queued runs remain forensically invisible (no receipt names the mechanism; this attribution cost a full Git archaeology pass). Extends the CF receipt-gap recommendation: queue transitions/supersessions need run-id-attributed durable receipts.
